formulaBlock.normalization: Packet canonicalInci used as normalized list (ID-2); positions are one-based on that list.

cleansingStrength.rationale: C6: no strong anionic; the earliest prominent surfactant is a mild anionic taurate (2) with prominent glucoside (3, 11) and amphoteric (4) co-surfactants -> low.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Amino-silicone (Amodimethicone 10) with a cationic starch (9), collagen (7) and weak refatters is one meaningful silicone/cationic system plus light routes -> moderate. C2 not met: no pearlizing/fatty route.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Silicone + cationic + protein + humectant (Urea 15) is close to the C2 set; could read as multiple complementary systems.

weightPotential.rationale: A prominent amino-silicone with a cationic starch, collagen and a film-type starch under a mild C6 chassis (weak reset) plausibly leaves noticeable but bounded residue -> moderate.
weightPotential.counterSignal: Weak reset plus several families (silicone, cationic polymer, protein, possible film former).

depositionLoad.rationale: Amodimethicone 10, Starch HPTC 9, collagen 7, potato-starch derivative 8, refatters 12/16/19.

persistence.rationale: Amodimethicone is substantive; cationic starch is light; no payload lipid.

weightPotential.whyThisBand: One meaningfully persistent amino-silicone system with light converging routes, weak reset.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: no W-RICH (no prominent payload lipid), the cationic is a light starch, and amodimethicone at 10 in a rinse-off is bounded. Not low: a prominent amino-silicone plus a cationic polymer under weak reset is a real deposition system (W2).
weightPotential.limitingFactor: Amodimethicone level; role of the potato-starch dodecenylsuccinate.

focusPrimary.rationale: Provisional: claims, name and directions are hidden in the blind pass (3.1); final value set after reconciliation (3.2). Formula care-direction verdict recorded for reconciliation.

careDirection.note: Amodimethicone (damage-selective deposition) + collagen + cationic starch = coherent substantive cluster; Urea/Lactate humectant route is thin.
